Pixmind Video Skill 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Generate AI videos from text prompts ("text-to-video") or animate existing images ("image-to-video") using the Pixmind API.
- Supports custom duration, aspect ratio, resolution, and model selection.
- Automatically chooses generation type based on user input (defaults to text-to-video).
- Provides instructions for script-based usage and response polling for task completion.
- Requires PIXMIND_API_KEY environment variable for authentication.
